response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM counts), above AS (SELECT c.cnt FROM counts c CROSS JOIN avg_c a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(ab.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(ab.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM above ab CROSS JOIN avg_c a;
